rows.text: does nothing when `rcx` is null or byte `+8` of `rcx` is nonzero; otherwise, when qword `+0` of `rcx` is non-null, calls the function at the call site `001EE180`+0x2A with that qword and, if its `al` result is nonzero, the function at the call site `001EE180`+0x36 with the same qword, then stores `dl` to byte `+9` of `rcx` (a null qword `+0` skips the calls and the store)
copies word `01E0C1D8` to word `01E0C1D4` and word `01E0C1DC` to word `01E0C1D6`
when `ecx` is nonzero stores dword 0x780 to `01E0C1D8` and 0x438 to `01E0C1DC`; when `ecx` is zero stores 0x200 and 0x1C0 to the same two dwords
